body: Closed the exact testing gap flagged when this bug was parked: registered a real disposable player account via IDUNA's own email/password auth, drove the real run_login_screen with synthetic typing (not the dev-agent bypass every earlier test used), then re-ran the worm-attack verification. Real login succeeded, avatar walked to the worm, attack command reached the server, worm died with real damage exchanged both ways. The underlying mechanic is confirmed correct end-to-end. No code changes -- nothing was found broken. Real gap: this environment can only test Linux/localhost, founder runs the Windows artifact over a real network; that difference can't be closed from here.
title: Right-click regression: real-login-path tested, combat mechanic confirmed sound
